The binary is conduwuit, the name the project still builds. io_uring is off: no pledge allows it. Sentry and OpenTelemetry are off. URL previews are built and allowlisted to nothing. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
